### 10/26/2026: High conversion-hazard run (Rashford et al. 2011)

```{r}
#| label: haz-setup
#| include: false
## Assets are written by 10d_results_assets_hazard.R from the canonical run (base)
## and the high-hazard run (alternative). Differences are high hazard − canonical.
hmeta <- tryCatch(
  jsonlite::read_json(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_metadata.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE),
  error = function(e) NULL)
haz_ok      <- !is.null(hmeta) && file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_headline.csv")) &&
               file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_value_added.csv"))
haz_ovl_ok  <- haz_ok && isTRUE(hmeta$overlap_drawn) &&
               file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_overlap.csv"))
haz_risk_ok <- haz_ok && isTRUE(hmeta$risk_drawn) &&
               file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig_haz_risk_box.png"))
haz_stale   <- haz_ok && isFALSE(hmeta$source_panel_md5_match)
HB <- if (haz_ok) hmeta$base_short else "Canonical"
HA <- if (haz_ok) hmeta$alt_short  else "High hazard"
HT <- if (haz_ok) hmeta$thresh_pp  else 2

## numbers used inline in the prose
h_target_yr  <- if (haz_ok) sprintf("%.2f%%", hmeta$target_annual_pct) else "?"
h_target_dec <- if (haz_ok) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * hmeta$target_decadal) else "?"
h_canon_dec  <- if (haz_ok) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * hmeta$canonical_mean_2020_weighted) else "?"
h_k          <- if (haz_ok) sprintf("%.2f", hmeta$k) else "?"

fmt_h1  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.1f%%", x))
fmt_hpp <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%+.1f", x))
fmt_hx  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.2f\u00d7", x))
fmt_hj  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.2f", x))

## Same table look as the comparison tables in 11b_landcover_comparison.qmd.
style_haz_table <- function(df, groups, subs, footer_text = NULL, bold_cells = NULL,
                            first_lab = "Scenario", font_size = 8.5) {
  rle_g <- rle(groups)
  seps  <- c(1, head(1 + cumsum(rle_g$lengths), -1))
  bd    <- officer::fp_border(color = "#dddddd", width = 1)
  ft <- flextable(df)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = setNames(as.list(c("", subs)), names(df)))
  ft <- add_header_row(ft, top = TRUE, values = c(first_lab, rle_g$values),
                       colwidths = c(1, rle_g$lengths))
  ft <- merge_at(ft, i = 1:2, j = 1, part = "header")
  ft <- bg(ft, part = "header", bg = GREEN_HEADER)
  ft <- color(ft, part = "header", color = "white")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- valign(ft, j = 1, valign = "center", part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, j = 1, part = "body")
  if (nrow(df) > 1) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2), bg = "#f5f5f2", part = "body")
  for (bc in bold_cells) ft <- bold(ft,  i = bc[1], j = bc[2], part = "body")
  for (bc in bold_cells) ft <- color(ft, i = bc[1], j = bc[2], color = "#B0413E", part = "body")
  ft <- border_remove(ft)
  ft <- hline(ft, i = 1, part = "header", border = officer::fp_border(color = "white", width = 1))
  ft <- vline(ft, j = seps, border = bd, part = "header")
  ft <- vline(ft, j = seps, border = bd, part = "body")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, padding.left = 3,
                padding.right = 3, part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = font_size, part = "all")
  ft <- autofit(ft)                      # header + body only: footer not added yet
  if (!is.null(footer_text)) {
    ft <- add_footer_lines(ft, values = footer_text)
    ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 7.5, part = "footer")
    ft <- color(ft, color = "grey40", part = "footer")
    ft <- align(ft, align = "left", part = "footer")
  }
  set_table_properties(ft, layout = "autofit")
}

                           HB, " vs. ", HA, " conversion risk.")
cap_haz_value    <- paste0("Acquisition value (cumulative discounted duck-pairs secured relative to the ",

                           " conversion risk, by scenario and policy.")
cap_haz_risk_fig <- paste0("**Per-period conversion risk across EAUs, by decade and emissions scenario.** Grey = ",
                           HB, "; red = ", HA, ". Box = median and IQR; diamond = mean; dash = maximum.")

```

In an effort to compare our model results to published literature which estimates the landscape-scale conversion rates of wetlands and grasslands, I re-ran the model with conversion risk rescaled to a high estimate of grassland conversion rates. Rashford et al. (2011) estimates that 1.33% of grasslands were lost across the PPR from 1979-1997, and is often cited as an upper bound on estimated cropland conversion rates. 1.33% per year translates to 12.5% per decade for our purposes. I re-scaled all conversion risk values so that the landscape-wide 2020 conversion rate — the share of all unprotected suitable habitat converted per decade — equals 12.5%, up from 1.7% in the original (FOREsce derived) run. The rescaling multiplies the underlying conversion rate by the same factor in every EAU, decade and scenario, so the spatial pattern and the trajectory of conversion risk over time (including the mid-century collapse under GCAM) are unchanged. Benefit, cost, budget and land cover are identical to the original run.

We find that the overall pattern of rolling outperforms myopic which outperforms greedy still holds. The performance gap, however, narrows. Rather than ~70% improvement of rolling > myopic, for example, we see ~ 35-40% improvement. I think this is likely because in a very high risk environment, the selection of particular parcels matters less than any selection at all. 

```{r}
#| label: tbl-haz-headline
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_haz_headline
#| eval: !expr haz_ok
hd <- read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_headline.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- data.frame(Scenario = unname(SCEN_LAB1[hd$scenario]),
                 rg_b = fmt_h1(hd$rg_pct_base), rg_a = fmt_h1(hd$rg_pct_alt), rg_d = fmt_hpp(hd$rg_pct_diff),
                 rm_b = fmt_h1(hd$rm_pct_base), rm_a = fmt_h1(hd$rm_pct_alt), rm_d = fmt_hpp(hd$rm_pct_diff),
                 ord  = ifelse(hd$ranking_holds, "Yes", "NO"), check.names = FALSE)
flags <- c(lapply(which(abs(hd$rg_pct_diff) > HT), function(i) c(i, 4)),
           lapply(which(abs(hd$rm_pct_diff) > HT), function(i) c(i, 7)),
           lapply(which(df$ord == "NO"),           function(i) c(i, 8)))
style_haz_table(df,
  groups = c(rep("Rolling vs. Greedy", 3), rep("Rolling vs. Myopic", 3), "Ranking holds"),
  subs   = c(HB, HA, paste0(DELTA, " pp"), HB, HA, paste0(DELTA, " pp"), "both runs"),
  bold_cells = flags,
  footer_text = c("% improvement = (rolling \u2212 comparison policy) as % of the comparison policy's value.",
                  paste0(DELTA, " pp = ", HA, " \u2212 ", HB, ", in percentage points; red = larger than ", HT, " pp.")))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-haz-value
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_haz_value
#| eval: !expr haz_ok
va <- read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "haz_value_added.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- data.frame(Scenario = unname(SCEN_LAB1[va$scenario]),
                 g_b = fmt_pairs(va$greedy_base),  g_a = fmt_pairs(va$greedy_alt),  g_r = fmt_hx(va$greedy_ratio),
                 m_b = fmt_pairs(va$myopic_base),  m_a = fmt_pairs(va$myopic_alt),  m_r = fmt_hx(va$myopic_ratio),
                 r_b = fmt_pairs(va$rolling_base), r_a = fmt_pairs(va$rolling_alt), r_r = fmt_hx(va$rolling_ratio),
                 check.names = FALSE)
style_haz_table(df,
  groups = rep(c("Greedy", "Myopic", "Rolling"), each = 3),
  subs = rep(c(HB, HA, "Ratio"), 3),
  font_size = 7.5,
  footer_text = paste0("Ratio = ", HA, " acquisition value / ", HB, " acquisition value."))
```
